musiccontrol.title: Music Control
musiccontrol.option.enabled.tooltip: When OFF, Minecraft's normal music comes back and none of your choices apply.
musiccontrol.option.switch.tooltip: Fade out the current song when it no longer fits where you are (for example, a Nether-only song after you leave the Nether) and pick one that does.
musiccontrol.option.gap.tooltip: How long to wait between songs while in a world. The title screen always uses short gaps.
musiccontrol.option.fallback.tooltip: What happens when none of your turned-on songs match the current situation. Silence keeps the music strictly to your choices.
musiccontrol.button.c418.tooltip: Turn on every C418 song and turn off all others. Each song keeps its conditions.
musiccontrol.button.all_on.tooltip: Turn on every song. Each song keeps its conditions.
musiccontrol.button.everywhere.tooltip: Remove every condition so any turned-on song can play in any world, mode, dimension and biome. Title-screen songs can still play on the title screen.
musiccontrol.button.reset_all.tooltip: Put every setting and every song back to this mod's defaults.
musiccontrol.songs.title: Songs
musiccontrol.rule.where.tooltip: Title screen, inside a world, or both.
musiccontrol.rule.other.tooltip: Any dimension that isn't the Overworld, Nether or End (from mods or datapacks).
musiccontrol.rule.underwater.tooltip: Whether your head must be underwater.
musiccontrol.rule.height.tooltip: Underground means you can't see the sky and you're below sea level.
musiccontrol.rule.play_now.tooltip: Play this song right away, ignoring its conditions.
